title: EssentialsExpertAIO
description: EssentialsExpert is a high-performance, modular core suite for Paper 1.21.1 that consolidates essential server management, player utilities, and economy features into a single, highly customizable framework.
body:
# 🛠️ EssentialsExpert **The definitive, high-performance modular core for modern Minecraft servers.** [![Target: Paper 1.21.1](https://img.shields.io/badge/Target-Paper%201.21.1-00ccff?style=for-the-badge&logo=minecraft)](https://papermc.io) [![Java: 21](https://img.shields.io/badge/Java-21-orange?style=for-the-badge&logo=openjdk)](https://www.oracle.com/java/) [![License: All Rights Reserved](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-All%20Rights%20Reserved-red?style=for-the-badge)](https://choosealicense.com/) --- ### ⚡ Overview `EssentialsExpert` is a modern, performance-first alternative to aging utility suites. Built from the ground up using **Java 21** and the **Kyori Adventure API**, it offers superior optimization, full hex-color support, and a "Single-Config" philosophy designed for the modern server owner.
--- ### 📦 Key Features * **🧩 Modular Architecture** Total control via a toggle-based system. If a module (Auction House, Trade, Vaults, etc.) is disabled, the plugin won't even register the commands, keeping your server lean and your `/help` menu clean. * **🚀 Performance Caching** Designed for high-traffic environments. By utilizing intelligent memory-caching for player data and auction listings, EssentialsExpert ensures zero-lag performance even under heavy loads. * **💰 Hybrid Economy** Features a built-in economy engine powered by SQLite for standalone use. Need more? It is fully compatible with **Vault**, allowing it to hook into your existing providers seamlessly. * **🛡️ Secure Trading** A secure, GUI-based trading system with a 16-block distance limit and strict "abort" logic (movement, interaction, or commands) to eliminate duplication exploits. * **⚖️ Auction House** A professional BIN (Buy It Now) marketplace with customizable tax rates, expiration handling, and a dedicated management GUI for players. * **📝 Bug Reporting** An integrated system for players to report issues directly to an SQLite database. Staff receive real-time alerts with **clickable teleport links** to the exact issue coordinates. * **🔇 Dynamic Messaging** Total control over every string. Set any message to `''` in the `messages.yml` to silence it completely—no blank lines, no spam. --- ### 📂 Configuration * **Master Config:** Manage your entire server logic in one strictly organized `config.yml`. * **Kits System:** Dedicated `kits.yml` for clean item metadata and cooldown management. * **Modern Formatting:** Full support for **MiniMessage** and **Hex Gradients** across all menus and messages. --- ### 🛠️ Technical Requirements | Requirement | Detail | | :--- | :--- | | **Server Version** | Paper or Purpur **1.21.1** (Recommended) | | **Java Version** | **Java 21** or higher | | **Permissions** | Compatible with **LuckPerms** | | **Economy** | **Vault** (Soft-dependency) | ---
**Built for performance. Built for the modern server owner.**
